items.quote: 30:17 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 30:18 Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to make a brass laver with a brass foot, used for washing.
items.object: laver of brass with foot of brass

items.quote: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
items.claim: The text says the laver was to be placed between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar and filled with water.
items.place: between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar
